fields.statement: At fd593c2: review-workflow.txtar runs `rhiza run start --workflow review` on a change set built on main (builder commits with Leaf: trailers plus verifier Evidence per leaf): the code step passes; cycle 1 runs compliance, quality, qa, scope and model on opus; quality reports a major on alpha and its critic confirms it (verdict confirmed); cycle 2 runs alpha's fixer then alpha's verifier, then only quality re-runs and passes (want.log cmp plus per-check cycles from run status --json: every other check has cycle 1 only). The fake qa check writes alpha-qa-1 Evidence; the engine commits it alone as 'chore(rhiza): record qa check writes' with an Actor trailer equal to the qa session's own RHIZA_ACTOR and no Leaf: trailer, and the fixer's commit holds only alpha.txt. rhiza run build-check exits 0, rhiza run approve ends the run succeeded at signoff, and rhiza change show reports state accepted, not landed; fold-ok. TestScripts/describe-golden passes at fd593c2, so the golden is current (no request/response type changed). builtin/review.toml: code command step with no on.fail, a review checks step with the five checks and critic/fixer/verifier all on opus, and signoff on.pass=done, on.changes=review, with no land step. A built binary dry-runs `run start --workflow review` in a scratch repo, current step code. TestReviewBuiltin, TestCommitCheckWrites/None, TestChecksStepCommitsWrites and the full suite pass.
